$comment: A plugin that exports `then`, which makes its module namespace a thenable. Both hosts import the namespace statically and never settle a promise with it, so the `then` is never run and the plugin loads and answers. Each case is its own plugin, `<case>/<case>-plugin.js`, called once for `fine` with `budgetMs` as its call budget. test/exported-then.test.js walks it through the CLI's engine and ExportedThenRecordTest through the device's runtime. The CLI used to settle the namespace, so these ran its `then`, and the last two hung it for good (found in review of kangzj/yonto#630).
